capabilities: run LaTeX-OCR on an image from the ribbon or command palette
convert equation images to raw LaTeX code for markdown files
show LaTeX-OCR running status as optional status bar text
extras: Only works if LaTeX-OCR is installed locally; the README does not cover setup or usage details.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn an image of an equation into editable LaTeX code, requiring manual transcription.
summary: Local runner for LaTeX-OCR that converts equations in images to LaTeX code for use in markdown notes.
